paths.title: Arena Champion
paths.description: Fight like a showman who knows exactly where to hurt an opponent. Spending an action point leaves every enemy you hit easier to strike, while taking total defense sharpens your next attack with Charisma or Wisdom. A well-placed strike weakens a foe, and a successful Bluff for combat advantage earns a free basic attack. When you are dropped, you can spend a healing surge to keep fighting, and your finishing blow leaves a victim bleeding and exposed.

paths.title: Blade Bravo
paths.description: Scrap like a street brawler who never needed a fancy flourish. Hitting an enemy that grants you combat advantage lets you mark it, and when a foe swings and misses, an action point turns into a punishing riposte that hits harder against marked enemies. A barbed taunt hauls a victim into reach for a second cut, your melee attacks can turn rattling, and every shift leaves you a little harder to hit. Your best trick is a parry that cripples whoever just struck you.

paths.title: Cat Burglar
paths.description: Treat the battlefield as a playground of ledges, gaps and escape routes. Action points grant an extra move action, and you shrug off some of the distance when enemies push, pull or slide you. You roll Athletics checks twice, strike with a gambit that shifts you in and out of the fight, and slip free the moment something would hold you down. Your greatest trick redirects an enemy's blow onto another of its allies.

paths.title: Cloaked Sniper
paths.description: Pick fights from the shadows with a crossbow, reaching farther and reloading faster than any ordinary shooter. A well-aimed bolt from hiding leaves the target dazed, and a miss costs you nothing because you can stay hidden and slip a step away. Your action point shot can add Sneak Attack damage a second time in the same round, and you can fire a hand crossbow in melee without drawing attacks. Your finest bolt strikes fear into a whole cluster of enemies.

paths.title: Daggermaster
paths.description: Make the dagger an extension of your own hand, hitting with a keener edge and a far better chance to land a critical hit. Your action points reroll a dagger attack or damage roll instead of granting an extra action, and a critical hit leaves the target open to your next strikes. A follow-up attack rewards you for scoring a crit, you can focus until the blade bites with a larger die, and your best attack leaves an enemy bleeding heavily.

paths.title: Daring Acrobat
paths.description: Bound across the fight with the grace of a circus performer, treating every jump and roll as part of your attack. Action points grant an extra move action, you give up no advantage while balancing, climbing or prone, and a charge leaves you harder to hit and free to keep acting afterward. A wild charging cut trades safety for damage, a flawless stunt lifts your Acrobatics and Athletics, and your dramatic finish turns a wounded foe into an extra attack or a healing surge.

paths.title: Daring Slinger
paths.description: Prove that a humble sling can outshoot any bow. You deal extra damage with the weapon, ignore the penalty for long range, and shoot past cover provided by an enemy's allies. An action point shot lands with steadier damage and leaves its target dazed. Scattershot pelts several foes and shoves them back, a missed shot can give you a second try with your encounter power, and your strongest shot leaves a victim dazed, slowed and exposed.

paths.title: Death Dealer
paths.description: Fight without mercy and make every kill a warning to the rest. Enemies beside you struggle to shake off their ailments, an action point makes every damage die hit harder, and bloodied foes feed you temporary hit points through Strength or Charisma. A probing strike steadies you with temporary hit points, finishing an enemy makes those who watched fear you, and your deadliest cut leaves ongoing damage and lets you press forward to follow the bleeding target.

paths.title: Gatecrasher
paths.description: Cut through the planes the way other rogues cut purses. Your action points add a teleporting move, portals reveal their true nature to you, and you gain an edge whenever an enemy teleports in your sight. A gate strike carries you across the field to gain combat advantage, a pair of linked gates lets your allies hop between squares, and your best attack opens a portal beside the target so you can strike from across the battlefield.

paths.title: Guildmaster Thief
paths.description: Run your allies like a crew that knows its trade. An action point can come out of an ally's pool, and the swap sharpens your aim, while nearby friends sneak and pick locks better. Charisma makes your flanking partners hit harder, your beatdown gives an adjacent ally a free swing, and a well-timed redirect lets a friend slip out of reach after a miss. Your daily strike lets the whole crew shift, whether you hit or miss.

paths.title: Jack-of-All-Trades
paths.description: Do a little of everything and do most of it well. A bonus to every skill check and training in three more skills reward your wide learning, and your action points make each check better still. Attacks that daze, a free reroll when a skill check goes badly, and a signature daily that tests all four defenses at once reward versatility. When your tricks line up, you slide across the field with a shift for every defense you break.

paths.title: Master Spy
paths.description: Slip among your enemies as one of their own and turn their plans against them. Action points leave you concealed and steady in motion, and a minor action Bluff can hand you combat advantage on an adjacent foe. A single attack reveals your target and hampers its stealth, a quick change makes it treat you as an ally, and once per encounter you share the benefit of a power aimed at another enemy. Your daily answer to a missed attack aims that attack right back at its owner.

paths.title: Rakish Swashbuckler
paths.description: Meet every threat with a smirk and a keen blade. Your action points make enemies miss you more often, those marked by others take a penalty against you, and enemies you mark grant combat advantage to your allies. An abashing stab invites a foe to strike you, your footwork shifts you or slides your enemy whenever you hit with advantage, and your daily assault weakens, slows and marks a target. When an ally scores a critical hit, you pounce with a free basic attack.

paths.title: Raven Herald
paths.description: Serve as the Raven Queen's instrument against the undead and anyone who has cheated their end. You gain Ritual Caster, training in Religion and a steadier grip on death saving throws, while action point attacks aim better at bloodied or undead enemies. Your Sneak Attack can burn with radiant damage, your strikes carve deeper into the same foes, and a spiritlike veil lets you vanish when something bloodies you. Your daily blow stuns bloodied or undead targets outright.

paths.title: Red Cloak
paths.description: Run the rooftops in a crimson cloak and punish anyone who thinks they can catch you. Action points maximize your Sneak Attack damage, and enemies that miss let you shift away or gain combat advantage against them. You can answer a hit with a reliable counterattack using a rapier or short sword, and your greatest rebuttal knocks a foe prone so it cannot stand quickly. Even your immediate actions come cheaper when they miss every target.

paths.title: Shadow Assassin
paths.description: Strike from the shadows and make every enemy regret returning the favor. Your action points grant a large attack bonus, a missing adjacent foe takes damage from your counterstrike, and bloodied enemies suffer additional Sneak Attack damage. An opening strike hits harder against a foe that has yet to act, a daily reaction hardens your defenses and doubles the counterstrike if the attack misses, and your final blow finishes a bloodied target before you shift up to your Charisma.

paths.title: Strong-Arm Enforcer
paths.description: Make fear your best weapon and every fight a lesson. Your action points make your attacks rattling, and rattling hits against enemies you have advantage on grant temporary hit points and later let you mark the target and strike harder with Charisma. A painful reminder strikes a foe you hit last turn and shoves it aside, an implied threat sharpens your Intimidate with Strength, and your callous daily strike drives nearby enemies back in fear.

paths.title: Whisperknife
paths.description: Hunt down wrongdoers with a thrown or held dagger and whispered vengeance. Light blade attacks at range no longer draw opportunity attacks, you gain Quick Draw, and action point attacks damage every adjacent enemy equal to your Dexterity. Positioning against larger foes makes you harder to flank and shoot. A pursuit strike lets you throw at a fleeing target, an ally's pain speeds you toward the attacker, and your daily blades fling a foe away before you leap in again.
